identity_check: Confirmed as 1Buy.AI (1buy.ai; legal entity Sharpbuy Global Solutions Private Limited per Inc42's profile), the Delhi electronics-procurement startup co-founded in 2023 by Visham Sikand, Nitin Jain and Pradeep Paliwal. The site's team page (read from the site's JavaScript bundle because the pages render client-side) names the same three co-founders as Entrackr, Entrepreneur India and Inc42 (January 2026 seed round), and Venture Intelligence links the deal to 1Buy.ai. Category set to 'adjacent' (not in the PROJECT_CONTEXT §7 seed list; candidate from a discovery search). 1Buy.AI works on manufacturers' bills of materials: it ingests a BOM from the ERP or an upload, flags price gaps, qualified alternates and supply risk (1Data), executes sourcing of high-impact parts with vetted global suppliers (1Source) and liquidates excess and end-of-life stock through a marketplace (1Xcess). That overlaps Utopian Autonomy's procurement and BOM functions for Indian manufacturers. It is not 'direct' because it covers only electronic components (EV, smart meters, industrial and consumer electronics), works partly as a sourcing and resale intermediary that positions itself against distributors rather than as plant-staff agents, and does not touch maintenance, process stability, RFQs for fabricated parts or engineering drawings; no WhatsApp channel was seen.

layer_detail: Direct-material procurement for electronics makers rather than the plant floor (no procurement layer in the taxonomy; plant_ops is the nearest fit, as for Procol and Didero). Five-step flow: upload a BOM or connect the ERP, AI flags price gaps, qualified alternates and risk, the buyer decides to renegotiate, re-source or hold, high-impact parts are sourced through 1Source, and excess or end-of-life stock is sold through 1Xcess. Target segments: EVs, smart meters, industrial and consumer electronics. No WhatsApp channel seen.
product_summary: Procurement platform for electronic components: it ingests a customer's bill of materials, benchmarks component prices, alternates and supply risk with AI (1Data), runs sourcing for high-impact parts through vetted global suppliers (1Source), and resells excess and obsolete inventory to approved buyers (1Xcess).
